body: Consensus best practice: ground the model in primary documents or a data MCP (never rely on model memory for numbers), use role-based adversarial prompts (bull/bear, pre-mortem, forensic accountant, short-seller), screen quantitatively first and use AI for the deep dive, and require citations/quotes for every figure.

- Theme map [BACKGROUND, not re-verified this session]: PLI schemes (14 sectors announced 2020–21, incl. mobiles/electronics, pharma, autos, specialty steel, textiles, solar modules) underpinned EMS (Dixon, Kaynes, Amber, PG Electroplast, Syrma) and solar manufacturing (Waaree, Premier Energies); China+1 helped specialty chemicals (which de-rated 2022–24) and EMS; defence indigenisation (HAL, BEL, Mazagon Dock, BDL, Data Patterns) and railways (IRFC, RVNL, Titagarh) were 2023–24 PSU re-ratings that corrected in 2025; power/capital goods (Siemens, ABB, CG Power, BHEL, transformers/cables) on transmission & data-centre capex; financialisation (BSE, MCX, CDSL, CAMS, KFin, HDFC AMC, Nippon AMC) on demat/SIP growth — note F&O curbs hit exchange volumes; premiumisation (Radico Khaitan, United Spirits; also jewellery/Titan) vs mass consumption slowdown.
- With large caps near long-run averages and small caps still premium, a stock-picking process should demand earnings delivery rather than re-rating in small caps.

body:
- **id:** `thesis:paper-call:US-MPWR:material-weakness-remediated-fy26-10k`
- **Method:** flags-judgment context · **P(ours)** 0.55 · **P(base)** 0.65 · resolve by 2027-03-15
- **Evidence:** Q3 2026 10-Q: a material weakness 'related to the accounting for deferred income taxes' associated with 'a one-time tax incentive granted by a certain foreign jurisdiction' was identified at FY2025 year-end; it 'was not remediated as of September 30, 2026'; disclosure controls 'not effective'; management still concluded the financial statements are fairly presented. Business is strong: Q3 2026 revenue $1,202.4m (+63.1% YoY, +22.6% QoQ), non-GAAP gross margin 55.7%, Q4 guide $1,315–1,385m; capacity $6bn → $8bn by H2 2027.
- **Why our number differs from base:** Flags-judgment: this flag is narrow (one tax-accounting area, not revenue) and low-teeth for the business, but the event is about remediation itself. Nine months in with no remediation claim and a fast-growing, more complex foreign-tax footprint argues for some slippage; still, single-area tax weaknesses at well-funded companies are usually closed within a year.
- **Base-rate reasoning:** Reference class (unverified, Audit Analytics-type studies from memory): roughly two-thirds of material weaknesses disclosed in a 10-K are reported remediated in the next annual report.
- **Resolution rule:** YES if MPWR's 10-K for fiscal year ended 31-Dec-2026 states that internal control over financial reporting was effective as of 31-Dec-2026 and that the previously reported material weakness has been remediated (and no new material weakness is reported). NO otherwise, including if the 10-K is not filed by 15-Mar-2027.
- **Resolution source:** SEC EDGAR — MPWR FY2026 Form 10-K, Item 9A
- **Sources used:** https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1280452/000162828026068202/mpwr-20260930xexx991.htm; https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=1280452&type=10-Q
- **Confidence of evidence:** single-source

body:
- Last 6 earnings calls on NSE (Q1FY26 to Q2FY27), fetched with `tools/promise_tracker/pipeline/fetch.py --since 2025-01-01`; `turns.py` + `candidates.py` (rules) produced the candidate sentences.
- LLM step done by Claude by hand: full opening remarks, every tier-A or volunteered guidance sentence, and targeted greps of later calls for outcomes. Restatements are folded into the first promise (`later_restatements`), not double-counted.
- Outcomes: group numbers from screener.in consolidated (re-derived: growth and OPM computed from the quarterly table); segment, SOP and order figures from the company's own later calls (single-source).
- Scoring: pilot formula unchanged (`scripts_TD_peers/build_seed.py`; T&D clarifications A-D apply). Credit delivered 1 / partly 0.5; MCS weights specificity x materiality x recency.
